avoid_supplements.name: High-dose Iron supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Iron may bind mesalamine in GI tract and reduce absorption; mesalamine may impair iron absorption
avoid_supplements.action: Separate administration by at least 2 hours; monitor for anemia

avoid_supplements.name: Lactulose (high doses)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May alter colonic pH and reduce mesalamine efficacy in inflammatory bowel disease
avoid_supplements.action: Coordinate use with gastroenterologist; monitor disease control

caution_supplements.name: Probiotics
caution_supplements.mechanism: May enhance mesalamine efficacy; generally synergistic but effects not fully standardized
caution_supplements.action: Monitor therapeutic response; use established probiotic strains

caution_supplements.name: Curcumin/Turmeric
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential additive anti-inflammatory effects; may enhance mesalamine benefits in IBD
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for excessive GI effects; may require dose adjustment of either agent

avoid_foods.name: High-fiber foods (during acute flares)
avoid_foods.mechanism: May increase bowel transit time and reduce mesalamine contact time with inflamed mucosa
avoid_foods.action: Restrict during acute disease exacerbation; reintroduce as symptoms resolve

caution_foods.name: Dairy products
caution_foods.mechanism: May contain calcium that could theoretically affect drug absorption; often triggers in IBD patients
caution_foods.action: Individualize based on tolerance; separate mesalamine dosing from high-calcium foods if concerned

caution_foods.name: Spicy foods
caution_foods.mechanism: May irritate inflamed GI mucosa; not a direct drug interaction but may exacerbate symptoms
caution_foods.action: Advise dietary tolerance assessment; not contraindicated but symptom-dependent

monitoring_notes: Mesalamine has minimal drug metabolism and hepatic interaction potential. Monitor renal function periodically, as mesalamine is renally excreted and acetylated metabolites may accumulate. Assess therapeutic efficacy in IBD control and watch for signs of renal impairment or sulfasalazine-like reactions.
